findings.title: Ambiguous lowercase markers are assigned the wrong hierarchy
findings.description: backend/services/legal_chunker.py::_marker_level checks Roman spelling before single lowercase markers, so real nested markers such as (c) in an (a)-(c) sequence can become a Roman peer or a child of (b). This corrupts canonical paths, attachment, breadcrumbs, and citations. Disambiguate using expected tier, indentation, ancestors, and marker sequence, and add realistic (i)->(a),(b),(c) regressions.

findings.title: Parent and nested canonical clause paths cannot reliably resolve containing children
findings.description: The chunker emits Roman children and gives every structural split the Roman path, while VectorStore.get_children_by_clause_paths and lexical boosting require exact equality with that one path. Queries such as B.2(B)(i)(a) and references such as I.3(B) can miss stored containing/descendant source. Persist/index contained-clause aliases or actual split-item paths and resolve governing paths to a bounded deterministic set of same-document descendants; test a parent target with Roman children.

findings.title: Delete can race a scheduled ingestion and resurrect orphan vectors
findings.description: DocumentService.upload schedules an untracked task before it acquires the semaphore. An immediate delete can remove metadata first, after which the pending task inserts searchable records for the deleted ID and may supersede prior same-filename data. Track/cancel or tombstone pending ingestions, re-check lifecycle state inside the semaphore, and add a barrier-controlled delete-before-ingest test across documents, parents, children, and vectors.

findings.title: Governing parent evidence is reported under the child citation
findings.description: Retrieval supplies parent.source_text[:600] inside a primary child's numbered prompt block, but ChatService creates only the child's clause/page citation. For later or cross-page children, the model can use text from another clause/page and return a false citation. Make the excerpt a separately provenance-bearing context/citation, restrict it to non-evidentiary headings, or ensure the selected excerpt and citation span cover every quoted source segment; add a cross-page test.

findings.title: Raw text and source spans are not faithful immutable provenance
findings.description: After cleaning can remove line breaks, _document_lines pairs clean and raw lines by index, reuses one whole-block span for every line, and split/table/front-matter records often store normalized reconstructions as raw_text. Preserve offset-aware mappings and original raw slices separately from normalized source_text, and test dehyphenation followed by additional lines plus split-child span round trips.

findings.title: Multi-page tables lose continuation semantics and legal location
findings.description: _stitch_tables only concatenates equal-header rows; it never forward-fills visually unambiguous continuation cells. Blank-key rows can be detached at chunk boundaries and receive whole-table page ranges, while table records discard the nearest title/clause and use only a running section and generic heading. Retain row geometry, fill only provable continuations, preserve title/clause breadcrumbs, and test repeated-header continuation rows with exact provenance.

findings.title: Identical content uploaded under another filename collides on global IDs
findings.description: Stable IDs omit filename/document ID, the database keys are globally unique, and replacement deletes only the incoming filename. Uploading the same bytes as a second filename therefore fails on existing parent/child/vector IDs, regressing the prior upload contract. Separate stable content identity from per-ingestion storage keys or implement explicit deduplication/aliases with safe deletion, and test two filenames with identical bytes.

findings.title: Required real Ollama passage-to-answer smoke evidence is missing
findings.description: legal-verification.md says the live smoke was not run, and authorised-dealers-smoke.md does not exist. The fake all-equal embedding sample neither validates real semantic retrieval nor generates an LLM answer. Strengthen the harness to require both Financial Surveillance Department verification and bona-fide/legitimacy proof, run it with the specified local models, and retain the answer/citation and DB-cleanup report.
